summary: The Muramite Industrial Territories are the manufacturing heart of the Muramite Dominion, producing weapons, armor, siege engines, and Discord‑charged materials for the Citadel and the warfronts.
history: Constructed after the Citadel Complex reached operational capacity.
Designed to mass‑produce Discord‑forged warsteel and arcane cores.
Dragorn slaves were forced to build the foundries and refineries.
The Discord Reactor was installed to power industrial processes.
Currently serves as the primary supply chain for Muramite warfronts.
